name: @property-assistant/web
description: Chat UI for testing the chatbot API (React + Vite).

scripts.build:deps: npm run build --workspace=@property-assistant/contracts && npm run build --workspace=@property-assistant/chat-ui
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:deps && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.build:embed: npm run build:deps && vite build -c vite.embed.config.ts
scripts.dev:embed: npm run build:deps && vite build -c vite.embed.config.ts --watch
